lines.en: I hang from the treetop and sway along.
My feet never touch ground; does that count?
Branch after branch, I move above you.
I drift slowly over your head.
Do not look up, eye contact is risky.

lines.zh: 垂下来的手指掠过树叶。
lines.en: My dangling fingers brush the leaves.

lines.zh: 我顺着藤蔓滑到你前面。
lines.en: I slide down a vine ahead of you.

lines.zh: 脚步没有声音，只有摆动。
lines.en: No footsteps, only a swinging rhythm.
You take a step and I swing once.
Hanging forward is steadier than running.
That leg in the tree shadow is mine.

lines.zh: 一路的枝丫都替我接力。
lines.en: Every branch hands me along the way.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树荡到下一棵。
lines.en: I swing from this tree to the next.
Look up and I am passing overhead.

lines.zh: 我的脚尖扫过草丛，草不动。
lines.en: My toes sweep the grass and it doesn't move.

lines.zh: 我吊着滑过去，像一根绳。
lines.en: I slide along hanging, like a rope.
Hanging still makes my neck ache.
I dangle here and watch you work.
The wind turns me halfway around.
This tree belongs to me today.

lines.zh: 你砍树前，最好先看看上面。
lines.en: Before you chop, check above you.
I give my weight to the branch.
Time moves slowly while suspended.
Fallen leaves stick to my sleeves.
I will not come down or go far.
My fingers carved five marks in bark.
On the seventh swing I stop.
Quiet as an old coat on a hook.
You passed three times; I stayed.
This posture is bad for my back.

lines.zh: 雾从树下升起来，正合我意。
lines.en: Fog rises under the trees. Just what I like.
I count branches, stopping wherever I stop.

lines.zh: 从上面看，你的头顶很小。
lines.en: From up here your head looks small.
I lower my head as you look up.
My eyes wait between the leaves.
Do not wave; I am not fruit.
You watch the tree; the tree watches back.

lines.zh: 这个角度，你的表情很新鲜。
lines.en: From this angle your face is new.
I tilt my head and study you upside down.
My gaze hangs down like a rope.

lines.zh: 你在找什么？我在你上方。
lines.en: What are you seeking? I am above.
Do not raise a torch, too bright.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的后颈看很久。
lines.en: I stare at the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我挂在梁上。
lines.en: You still have not seen me on the beam.

lines.zh: 我们对视，树枝响了一声。
lines.en: We lock eyes and a branch creaks.

lines.zh: 从雾里垂下的一双眼睛。
lines.en: A pair of eyes hangs out of the mist.

lines.zh: 你抬头的瞬间，我别过脸。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I turn my face away.
Hit me and the branch shivers too.
What you cut was the branch I hold.
I slide half a block down the trunk.
It hurts, but I keep my grip.

lines.zh: 这一箭把我钉在树干上。
lines.en: This arrow pins me to the tree.
My swinging only gets wilder.
Blood drips onto the fallen leaves.
You struck the foot that dangles.
I grunt once and keep hanging.
Let go? Not yet.

lines.zh: 小麦举再高，也够不到我。
lines.en: Raise the wheat higher; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我挂得太久，忘了怎么吃。
lines.en: Hanging so long, I forgot how to eat.

lines.zh: 你手里的苹果，不如树皮。
lines.en: Your apple is worth less than bark.
Put the food down and look up.
I am not hungry, only suspended.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜插在土里吧。
lines.en: Plant that carrot in the soil.
Feed me? First let me land.
Upside down, I cannot swallow.
Eating in this pose would choke me.

lines.zh: 甜菜根的味道飘不上来。
lines.en: The beetroot smell never climbs this high.

lines.zh: 你留着自己吃，我不下树。
lines.en: Keep it; I am not coming down.

lines.zh: 我用饥饿换了一根好树枝。
lines.en: I traded hunger for a good branch.
Do not offer bread for my perch.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是树叶，不是麦子。
lines.en: I smell leaves, not wheat.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我够得着但不吃。
lines.en: You hold it up high. I could reach it, but I won't.
I let go one hand and point at you.
What you hit was my ankle.

lines.zh: 我从树上垂下来，刚好挡路。
lines.en: I dangle from the tree into your path.

lines.zh: 头碰到我，像碰到冷木头。
lines.en: Your head meets me like cold wood.
You pull back and I keep swinging.

lines.zh: 这一下把树叶都震落了。
lines.en: The bump shakes loose a dozen leaves.
Do not push, I am holding a branch.
Apologize upward after you bump me.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖在你肩膀高度。
lines.en: My knee hangs at your shoulder height.
Two of us crowd under one tree.
A dead leaf sticks to your coat.
Only one of me fits in this tree.
Paired up, the branch would snap.
How would something like me court?
Hanging posture is not made for closeness.

lines.zh: 别给我找伴，我会掉下来。
lines.en: Do not find me a mate; I would fall.
Two of us swinging would be noisy.
My kind exists only inside fog.
The young would drop straight down.
Hanging alone for years suits me.
That question nearly loosened my grip.
My hands are busy holding the tree.

lines.zh: 松手的东西，就归大地了。
lines.en: What leaves my hand belongs to the ground.
The arrow you dropped lies in leaves.
I could reach it, but I will not.
Picking things upside down looks bad.

lines.zh: 那顶头盔，挂在枝上刚好。
lines.en: That helmet looks fine on the branch.
I only collect tree shadows.
When something lands, I let go.
You pick it up; I will not compete.
Bark in my fist is enough.
The branch dips; I have marked you.

lines.zh: 你从树下走过，就是答案。
lines.en: Walking under this tree was your answer.
I release one hand, which means locked.
The shadow overhead stops moving.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声，是树在响。
lines.en: That creak you heard was the tree.
The target stands directly below me.

lines.zh: 我选人不看脸，看脚步声。
lines.en: I choose by footsteps, not faces.
Hanging in the fog, I picked you.
Stop walking; my grip is slipping.

lines.zh: 这一棵树，正好在你路上。
lines.en: This tree happens to stand on your road.
Wherever you run, I hang nearby.
Between trees I am faster than you.

lines.zh: 别钻进林子，那是我的家。
lines.en: Do not enter the woods, that is my home.

lines.zh: 我垂着追，晃得很有节奏。
lines.en: I chase while dangling, swinging in rhythm.
When you look up, I switch branches.

lines.zh: 你的路线，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: I see your whole route from above.

lines.zh: 我数着你经过的每棵树。
lines.en: I count every tree you pass.
That horizontal branch ahead is taken.
Your breathing is easy to locate.
Chasing needs no legs, only gravity.

lines.zh: 从树上垂下的手，抓住了你。
lines.en: The hand from the branch caught you.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整棵树的重量。
lines.en: That blow carried the whole tree's weight.
I struck while hanging upside down.

lines.zh: 你抬头的瞬间，我落下半尺。
lines.en: You looked up and I dropped a foot.
My nails are long from gripping bark.
Do not stand under trees, you get hit.
I used the branch's spring against you.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你就记住悬挂了。
lines.en: One touch and you will remember hanging.

lines.zh: 这一掌，是树替我发的力。
lines.en: The tree lent me its force.
After the hit I swing back into shade.
Any biome, weight ten, one at a time.

lines.zh: 我从树上长出来，像颗坏果子。
lines.en: I grow out of the tree like bad fruit.

lines.zh: 生成条件很挑，挑中了你。
lines.en: The spawn conditions were picky, and picked you.

lines.zh: 这片林子今晚多了一件挂饰。
lines.en: This forest gained an ornament tonight.
You heard a branch bend once.
Only one arrives per attempt, enough.

lines.zh: 我挂在离地三格的地方。
lines.en: I hang three blocks above the ground.
Jungle or snowfield, I can hang anywhere.
The system called my name and I answered.

lines.zh: 头顶忽然多了一道影子。
lines.en: A shadow appeared above your head.

lines.zh: 我从雾里垂下来，落地无声。
lines.en: I lower out of the fog without a sound.
Stop searching; I am above you.

lines.zh: 火光烧到袖口，我荡开了。
lines.en: Fire caught my sleeve and I swung away.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，姿势很难看。
lines.en: I fell out of the tree, landing badly.

lines.zh: 水里没法悬挂，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water offers nothing to hang from; I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从枝头掀了下来。
lines.en: The blast tore me off the branch.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在树上，像标本。
lines.en: The arrow fixed me to the trunk like a specimen.

lines.zh: 魔法的光顺着藤蔓爬上来。
lines.en: Magic light crawls up the vine toward me.
Hanging so long, I forgot hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈中树，我跟着亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree and lit me up.

lines.zh: 虚空没有树枝，我无处可挂。
lines.en: The void has no branches to hang from.
